CustomField.description: Per-section multi-select of Salesforce matching rule developer names used to find existing Contacts for this section's related records during conversion. Read by Form_Submission_Convert_Setup's getPageSection branch as the section's own value; a blank checks every active Contact matching rule. The section never inherits the Form Template's Contact Matching Rules. Drives the Convert vs Related-Record routing and works with Update Most Confident Contact.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Choose which Contact matching rules conversion uses for this section's data. Leave blank to check every active Contact matching rule; pair with Update Most Confident Contact to control how multiple matches resolve.
CustomField.label: Contact Matching Rules
